title: Macrocyclic peptides as a new class of targeted protein degraders
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,326-337
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00199K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xuefei Jing, Joel P. Mackay, Toby Passioura
Targeted degraders and cyclic peptides are both emerging therapeutic modalities. This review describes recent efforts to combine these approaches, to generate cyclic peptidic targeted degraders with advantages over either parent technology.
